author: Ankit
problem: Read X, Y and N. Apples cost X yen each, or Y yen for a pack of three. Print, as an integer, the minimum cost of buying exactly N apples.
bug_description: Uses / instead of //, so the number of packs is a fraction and the cost is printed as a float.

comments.accurate: Buys as many 3-apple packs as possible when they're cheaper, and single apples for the rest
comments.wrong_behavior: When packs are cheaper, charges the pack rate per apple (Y/3) plus single prices for the leftover apples
comments.wrong_location: Pack arithmetic verified; check the price comparison when three singles cost exactly a pack
